product_one_liner.value: CoLab is AI-powered design-review and collaboration software for mechanical-engineering and hardware-development teams, helping them capture expert knowledge and make better, faster design decisions.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its AI-powered software as serving mechanical-engineering and hardware-development teams and its EngineeringOS as helping engineers make faster, better design decisions while capturing expert knowledge.

pricing_page.notes: The official homepage presents product information and demo/product-expert calls to action rather than pricing. The /pricing route likewise renders product/demo content without plans or prices, and the homepage has no pricing navigation/footer link.

eng_blog.notes: The blog indexes show mostly product-comparison and marketing articles. They identify one clear engineer-authored product-build post: CTO Jeremy Andrews's DFM article describing CAD-geometry analysis and large language models. The other inspected AI/CAD post is presented as an explanatory interview, not a second implementation post. The index evidence therefore does not meet the two-post threshold.

public_docs.notes: The public CoLab Help Center collection shows 39 articles and links to individual product-help articles, satisfying the multi-article documentation criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Greenhouse board lists current openings, including Senior 3D & AI Systems Software Developer, an AI-titled role.
